message: The default of the param 'top' of prefab Crate is not a constant expression: it refers to the param 'height'.
notes: a default may use only literals, constants, operators, conversions, constructors and const-eligible built-in functions

help: a default is fixed when the program is built; pass a value that is computed, or that changes, where the prefab is used (`entity Name: Prefab { param: value }` or `spawn(Prefab { param: value })`)
